pull_request.title: fix(config): machine-scope legacy critic/perltidy settings (#5001)
pull_request.body:
## Claim boundary (Phase 1 only)

**Proves:** VS Code resource/workspace settings and the LSP `didChangeConfiguration` channel cannot enable legacy perlcritic subprocess profile paths or external perltidy profile/extra-arg injection.

**Does not prove:** `.perl-lsp.toml` hardening, full 17-setting inventory gate (Phase 2), `includePaths`, or AI completion.

Closes #5001 (Phase 1).

issues.title: security(config): audit all resource-scoped settings for workspace-owned capabilities
issues.body:
## Work

1. Determine whether `perlcritic.profile` reaches a subprocess or filesystem read.
2. Audit every `scope: resource` setting.
3. Apply one trust-boundary fix shape.
4. Write the answer down as a checked-in table.

## Acceptance

- Every resource-scoped setting is classified.
- Capability-granting settings are hardened.
- A test covers committed workspace settings.
- Adding a setting without classification fails.
